messages.author: 7a2e66ed84f99876
messages.subject: Manipulation of a dataset
parts:
Hey there

I've a question about manipulation of datasets.

I'm trying to make a small program which can "remember" the last entries in a numericInput - field.

For example:

I've a matrix or data.frame which has two rows and two columns. All entries are 1. Additionally I've on SelectInput for the row and one for the column which I want to change. And I just want one numericInput for the new value of the field.

What I were able to do was just to overwrite the one field of the matrix with the numericInput. But my problem is, I want to change for example the field [1,2] to 2, the field [2,1] to 3 and [2,2] to 4. This matrix should than be plotted as output.
If I now change the first field again, the last Input must not be remembered anymore, I just want all four fields with the actual values in one matrix.

I don't want four different numericInputs, because this wouldn't work in my situation.

I'm just wondering if it's possible to safe the changed matrix after each step. And then iteratively take the new matrix for the next manipulation.

thanks for all kind of ideas and suggestions.

Kind Regards

Jürg
